messages:
anya: quick follow-up from the noon sync — we saw a ~15-40ms tail on smokewave routing when a KV-cache miss triggers bench probes. thinking: should we decouple prober work into a low-priority lane?
matt: can you paste the trace? is this queuing or sync work in the prober?
anya: trace (copied):
```
root: admit -> lookup(kv) -> bench-probe (sync) -> runtime-alloc -> model-serve
queue_wait: 23ms
bench-probe: 12ms
runtime-alloc: 8ms
```
anya: bench-probe currently does sync network calls to golden-service

dmitry: +1 to decouple. sync blocks the caller. async fire-and-forget avoids holding request context but makes correlating results harder
sarah: tradeoffs: async lowers tail but weakens gating. we might accept a model and later mark it unhealthy. how do we evict before it serves more traffic?
matt: two patterns:
- A: async probes + provisional admit flag + short canary (1% traffic) to fallback variant; revoke if probes fail
- B: keep sync for critical checks but replace with in-process microbench that exercises KV semantics only

anya: routing idea: route first N requests to a safer runtime variant (e.g., `quantized-safe`) until probes pass

dmitry: sketch config:
```
admit_policy:
  probe_mode: async
  provisional_window: 30m
  canary_percent: 1
  fallback_variant: quantized-safe
```

sarah: metrics question: async probes need admit_id to join probe results to the admit. else alerts are messy
matt: emit probe events with `admit_id` and a metric `admit_probe_result{admit_id,model,host}=pass|fail`. alert: fail_rate>5% over 10m -> revoke
anya: rough effort: async+admit_id ~2wks; canary routing ~1wk; alert automation ~1wk
sarah: ops: rollback must be idempotent. 2-step revoke: 1) remove canary routing, 2) mark model quarantined + trigger re-eval

dmitry: golden availability: probes need retry/backoff and a circuit-breaker so golden outages don't block admits

anya: proposed decision (thumbs):
- adopt async probes with admit_id
- provisional window 30m, 1% canary to fallback_variant
- auto-revoke when fail_rate > 5% in 10m
- add circuit-breaker for golden calls

matt: :+1:
sarah: :+1: will add runbook steps and model annotations
dmitry: :+1: I'll prototyped probe-event schema and canary flags

action items:
- dmitry: proto probe-event schema + minimal producer (PR by EOW)
- matt: canary routing + fallback wiring (RFC follow-up PR)
- sarah: update runbook & alerts
- anya: coordinate QA spike against staging goldens

anya: thanks — sync next Tue to review PRs
